text:
sofia: Heads up — several multi-GPU jobs on g5-pool-d started failing with NCCL hangs around 01:10 UTC, p99 latency spikes and sudden RX drop counters on mlx5. Anyone else seeing this?
ashwin: saw alerts, tickets spiked. Jobs report repeated `NCCL WARN AllReduce: unexpected p2p error`. GPU count per job unaffected but traffic stalls.
meera: repro'ed on a test job — when we ssh to nodes and run `nvidia-smi topo -m` topology looks fine but `dmesg` shows mlx5 warnings: `mlx5: drop err cqe rxq 0x...` and `ib_core: QP 0x...: unexpected state`.
sofia: Netbot dumped a quick summary: `netbot: spike in rx_dropped on tor-21:east1 01:08-01:12 UTC, LLDP flaps, ARP table churn on leaf-4`.
carlos: can you paste the `ibv_devinfo` output? I want to check MTU and max_sge.
ashwin: pasted snippet:
```
ibv_devinfo -v mlx5_0
    device part_num: MT_1234
    fw_ver: 16.27.1040
    phys_port_cnt: 2
    port 1:
        state: PORT_ACTIVE
        mtu: 4096
        gid_tbl_len: 128
```
sofia: MTU looks OK on the HCA (4096) but I noticed underlay shows some 1500/9000 mix on the path — vtep on leaf-4 has vxlan offload configured with 1500 inner MTU. Could cause fragment/invalidation for GPUDirect pages.
meera: when I lowered HCA MTU to 1500 on test node, the job stopped hanging but throughput dropped. Reproduces the problem: mismatch between HCA MTU and VXLAN inner MTU causes Rx reassembly failures, QP errors, and NCCL stalls.
carlos: is this only on g5-pool-d or spread across zones?
sofia: mostly g5-pool-d and a couple of older nodes in g5-pool-c. Looks correlated with a recent leaf roll (leaf-4) where we enabled VXLAN offload to reduce CPU on SNAT boxes.
nashwin: workaround idea: enable prefix-based RoCE path pinning to avoid VXLAN-egress on RDMA flows, or add explicit route for pod subnet via tor without encapsulation. Both are heavy.
meera: quick mitigation we applied: force jobs onto nodes with identical HCA MTU + disable VXLAN offload on leaf-4 for the affected pods. Reduced failures by ~80%.
sofia: can we get the infra team to rollback the offload change? Also need a long-term plan: either consistent MTU across underlay+overlay or avoid overlay for RDMA traffic.
carlos: opened INFRA-9212 requesting rollback and MTU audit across east1 racks. Added logs from `ethtool -k` and `ip -s link` for two suspect links.
netbot: deploy-bot: rollback scheduled for 02:00 UTC as a precaution (rolling, 5m drain per leaf).
nashwin: note for SRE/Cost — the workaround (packing jobs onto fewer nodes) temporarily increases contention; we might see higher queue times/cost until rollback.
meera: also saw a pattern of MR invalidations around the time of the VXLAN flaps: `ib_reg_mr: failed to register mr: -5` in kernel logs. That lines up with GPUDirect buffers getting unregistered mid-job.
sofia: post-rollback checks to run: 1) end-to-end iperf RDMA between pairs, 2) `ibv_rc_pingpong -d mlx5_0`, 3) run a small NCCL job with `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` and `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0` to ensure no p2p error.
carlos: I'm adding a flakiness gate to the scheduler for RDMA-heavy labels to avoid noisy leaves until we have deterministic fix.
meera: FYI, firmware on some MLX5 cards on g5-pool-d is 16.27.1040 — upstream notes mention a VXLAN offload interaction in 16.27.x that can cause RSS/packet steering corruption when inner MTU != HCA MTU. Might be worthwhile to bump fw after rollback.
sofia: thanks — ACTIONS: Carlos will track rollback and MTU audit, Meera will run the post-rollback validation checklist, Ashwin will monitor NCCL job queue and cost/p99 changes, I'll prepare a short postmortem once we stabilize.
carlos: INFRA-9212 updated with rollback logs, ETA 02:15 UTC.
nashwin: monitoring dashboards show p99 tokens for allreduce back to baseline after we disabled VXLAN offload on leaf-4. Keeping an eye for 30m. :eyes:
meera: added mitigation notes to runbook under `RDMA/overlays` — avoid VXLAN offload until MTU invariant proven.
sofia: big thanks team. If anyone runs into new symptoms, ping here. :thumbsup:
